:::{.about-content}
# Who We Are
The Caltech Bioinformatics Research Center develops bioinformatics workflows,
facilitates the analysis of biological data, benchmarks methods, and provides bioinformatics and statistics consulting. The center supports projects involving both technology development
and biological discovery, with current emphasis on bioinformatics for genomics, transcriptomics, and epigenomics.
:::
